note: REPLAY-ONLY, never read by the suite and not for adoption: `scripts/prechecks/replay.py` passes this file as `--ledger` so that the historical tips, whose base did not yet contain the accepted receipts, can be replayed as clean controls. On main, the base ratchet of C4 already suppresses host paths that the base has (a hit count at or below the base's is not a condition), so adopting an entry there would only silence the same path when it gains paths later; the ledger of record is docs/compiler-campaign/known-conditions.json on main, which the coordinator owns. Only C4 `host-path` entries are kept, each pinned to the measured hit count. No `frozen-edit`, `assertion-weakened` or `C1` condition is ever proposed: an entry for an edited frozen gate script would silence every later edit of that script (the fingerprint is the path).
